findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: call_log_exists is false and call_log_size_mb is null for expected log file /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure model router creates and writes invocation records to call_log.jsonl or update the configured log file path.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores full observability, auditing, and latency tracking for LLM routing.

findings.title: Direct LLM API invocations bypass centralized model router

evidence.observation: Direct call to call_gemini using GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable
Direct call to call_mistral using MISTRAL_API_KEY environment variable

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM requests through the centralized model router rather than calling provider APIs directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures centralized fallback policies, consistent caching, and unified usage tracking across services.
